Title: 1. Jenny Lamour
description: A jealous husband intends to kill the man his wife is meeting for business, but arrives to find the deed already done.

Title: 2. Monsieur Verdoux
description: A suave but cynical man supports his family by marrying and murdering rich women for their money, but the job has some occupational hazards.

Title: 3. It Always Rains on Sunday
description: An escaped convict tries to hide out at his former lover's house, but she has since married and is reluctant to help him.

Title: 4. Antoine & Antoinette
description: Working class couple Antoine and Antoinette dream of a better life. In the midst of constantly fending off the unwanted attention of men, especially the grocer Monsieur Roland, Antoinette purchases a winning lottery ticket. But when Antoine loses their ticket out of poverty, their dreams seem like they'll remain just that.

Title: 5. Out of the Past
description: A private eye escapes his past to run a gas station in a small town, but his past catches up with him. Now he must return to the big city world of danger, corruption, double crosses, and duplicitous dames.

Title: 6. The Lady from Shanghai
description: Fascinated by a gorgeous woman, a seaman joins a bizarre yachting cruise and ends up mired in a complex murder plot.

Title: 7. The Long Night
description: Police surround the apartment of apparent murderer Joe Adams, who refuses to surrender although escape appears impossible. During the siege, Joe reflects on the circumstances that led him to this situation.

Title: 8. Black Narcissus
description: Anglican nuns fight challenges, difficulties, temptation, low morale and cold at a Himalayan mission.

Title: 9. The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
description: In 1900, a young widow finds her seaside cottage is haunted and forms a unique relationship with the ghost.

Title: 10. Miracle on 34th Street
description: After a divorced New York mother hires a nice old man to play Santa Claus at Macy's, she is startled by his claim to be the genuine article. When his sanity is questioned, a lawyer defends him in court by arguing that he's not mistaken.

Title: 11. Angel and the Badman
description: Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl. He eventually finds himself having to choose between his world and the world Penelope lives in.

Title: 12. The Paradine Case
description: A happily married London barrister falls in love with the accused poisoner he is defending.

Title: 13. Life with Father
description: A straitlaced turn-of-the-century father presides over a family of boys and the mother who really rules the roost.

Title: 14. Dark Passage
description: A man falsely accused of his wife's murder escapes to search for the real killer.

Title: 15. The Bishop's Wife
description: A debonair angel comes to Earth to help an Episcopalian bishop and his wife in their quest to raise money for the new church.

Title: 16. Kiss of Death
description: A thief arrested for a jewelry heist initially refuses to give up his accomplices, but he changes his mind after his wife dies under mysterious circumstances.

Title: 17. Odd Man Out
description: A wounded Irish nationalist leader attempts to evade police following a failed robbery in Belfast.

Title: 18. Boomerang!
description: The true story of a prosecutor's fight to prove the innocence of a man accused of a notorious murder.

Title: 19. Brute Force
description: At a tough penitentiary, prisoner Joe Collins plans to rebel against Captain Munsey, the power-mad chief guard.

Title: 20. It Happened on Fifth Avenue
description: Two homeless men move into a mansion while its owners are wintering in the South.

Title: 21. Gentleman's Agreement
description: A reporter pretends to be Jewish in order to cover a story on anti-Semitism, and personally discovers the true depths of bigotry and hatred.

Title: 22. High Wall
description: After a brain-damaged war veteran confesses to murdering his wife and is sent to a psychiatric hospital, a sympathetic doctor tries to lead him to recover his memory of events as he begins to question his guilt.

Title: 23. Crossfire
description: A man is murdered, apparently by one of a group of demobilized soldiers he met in a bar. But which one? And why?

Title: 24. Body and Soul
description: A talented boxer's young career hits difficult terrain when an unethical promoter takes interest in him.

Title: 25. Possessed
description: After being found wandering the streets of Los Angeles, a severely catatonic woman tells a doctor the complex story of how she wound up there.

Title: 26. The Two Mrs. Carrolls
description: An artist forms an attachment with a woman on holiday in the country. As the relationship develops, his behavior and information about his past cause her increasing concern.

Title: 27. Blind Spot
description: An alcoholic struggling author is accused of murdering his publisher and sets out to discover the real killer, but is hampered by his inability to recall the events around the killing, including his plot for a potential new murder mystery.

Title: 28. Something in the Wind
description: A grandson of a recently deceased millionaire mistakes a beautiful female disc jockey for her aunt, who once dated the grandfather.

Title: 29. The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
description: A clumsy daydreamer gets caught up in a sinister conspiracy.

Title: 30. Nightmare Alley
description: The rise and fall of Stanton Carlisle, a mentalist whose lies and deceit prove to be his downfall.

Title: 31. Fun and Fancy Free
description: Jiminy Cricket hosts two Disney animated shorts: "Bongo," about a circus bear escaping to the wild, and "Mickey and the Beanstalk," a take on the famous fairy tale.

Title: 32. My Favorite Brunette
description: Shortly before his execution on the death row in San Quentin, amateur sleuth and baby photographer Ronnie Jackson tells reporters how he got there.

Title: 33. They Won't Believe Me
description: On trial for murdering his girlfriend, philandering stockbroker Larry Ballentine takes the stand to claim his innocence and describe the actual, but improbable-sounding, sequence of events that led to her death.

Title: 34. The Unsuspected
description: The secretary of an affably suave radio mystery host mysteriously commits suicide after his wealthy young niece disappears.

Title: 35. Song of the Thin Man
description: Nick and Nora Charles are on a gambling boat when someone is murdered. The two main suspects are at large and come to Nick for help. Nick turns them in to the police but then sets out to figure out the mystery.

Title: 36. Down to Earth
description: A goddess angered by a musical's take on Greek myths joins the show's cast and convinces the producer to make changes, but her revisions turn it into a failure.

Title: 37. Forever Amber
description: In seventeenth-century England, Amber St. Clair aims to raise herself from country girl to nobility, and succeeds, but loses her true love in the process.

Title: 38. Song of Love
description: Composer Robert Schumann struggles to compose his symphonies while his loving wife Clara offers her support. Also helping the Schumanns is their lifelong friend, composer Johannes Brahms.

Title: 39. Hue and Cry
description: A gang of street boys foil a master crook who sends commands for robberies by cunningly altering a comic strip's wording each week, unknown to writer and printer. The first of the Ealing comedies.

Title: 40. Heaven Only Knows
description: An angel is sent to earth to help save the soul of a saloon and gambling house owner.

Title: 41. Nora Prentiss
description: A doctor spins an ever-growing web of lies after a taste of the excitement that he was missing in his conventional life, thanks to a chance meeting with a nightclub singer.

Title: 42. I'll Be Yours
description: A small-town girl tells a small fib to a wealthy businessman; complications ensue.

Title: 43. Dark Delusion
description: A young doctor risks his career over his treatment of a beautiful socialite to whom he's attracted.

Title: 44. If Winter Comes
description: In 1939 England, a textbook writer's loveless marriage faces new challenges when his former love returns to town with her husband. As WWII erupts, his kindness toward a girl sparks rumors, while the war's impact reaches their community.

Title: 45. The Sea of Grass
description: On America's frontier, a St. Louis woman marries a New Mexico cattleman who is seen as a tyrant by the locals.

Title: 46. The Red House
description: An old man and his sister are concealing a terrible secret from their adopted teen daughter, concerning a hidden abandoned farmhouse, located deep in the woods.

Title: 47. Born to Kill
description: A calculating divorcée risks her chances at wealth and security with a man she doesn't love by getting involved with the hotheaded murderer romancing her foster sister.

Title: 48. The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
description: Romantic comedy about a high school girl who falls in love with a playboy artist. The girl's older sister, who's a judge, does not approve of the relationship.

Title: 49. Desert Fury
description: The daughter of a Nevada casino owner gets involved with a racketeer, despite everyone's efforts to separate them.

Title: 50. Lured
description: An American girl living in the UK is sent by the local police to help spy on a main suspect who lures and murders women, but accidentally falls in love with him.

Title: 51. Pursued
description: A boy haunted by nightmares about the night his entire family was murdered is brought up by a neighboring family in the 1880s. He falls for his lovely adoptive sister but his nasty adoptive brother and mysterious uncle want him dead.

Title: 52. I Walk Alone
description: Frankie Madison leaves prison expecting a share from his ex-partner. But Prohibition bootlegging didn't prepare Frankie for Big Business.

Title: 53. Secret Beyond the Door...
description: After a lovely woman and her new husband settle in an ancient mansion on the East Coast, she discovers that he may want to kill her.

Title: 54. Unconquered
description: Intrepid frontiersman Chris Holden foils the political and personal ambitions of renegade Martin Garth in the Ohio Valley following the French and Indian War.

Title: 55. Good News
description: Golden Globe winner June Allyson and Peter Lawford star in this enjoyable musical about a football hero who falls in love with his French tutor.

Title: 56. Dishonored Lady
description: A beautiful editor at a fashion magazine has a breakdown due to the pressures of her work and her disappointing love life. A psychiatrist recommends that she start life fresh by moving into a smaller apartment and under another name.

Title: 57. The Farmer's Daughter
description: After leaving her family's farm to study nursing in the city, a young woman finds herself on an unexpected path towards politics.

Title: 58. Moss Rose
description: Set in turn-of-the-century London, a woman trying to solve the mystery of a friend's murder finds that she may be the next victim.

Title: 59. Angelina
description: A rowdy woman is so forceful that she outdoes her husband in a loud cry against speculators who refuse poor people entrance to a block of new apartments, built after WW2. Without noticing it, she starts a people's movement, and leads a march to the capital. She returns to her village a winner, an honourable MP. Yet, she is still the same simple, fiery woman, able to get in a hair-pulling brawl with the local barmaid for the affection of her man.

Title: 60. The Web
description: An attorney acting as a body guard, apparently kills a man in defense of his employer's life, and later believes the victim was set up to be murdered.

Title: 61. Tycoon
description: In South America, an American engineer is asked by his boss to build a mountain railroad tunnel following a shorter but more dangerous route.

Title: 62. 13 Rue Madeleine
description: When spy chief Bob Sharkey finds out one of his agents-in-training is actually a Nazi double agent, his strategic decision not to arrest him results in tragedy.

Title: 63. Cynthia
description: Sickly girl finds an outlet in music.

Title: 64. A Double Life
description: A celebrated actor struggles to distinguish his own life from that of his most recent stage role, Othello.

Title: 65. Captain from Castile
description: The invasion of Mexico by Cortez, as seen by a young Spanish officer fleeing the Inquisition.

Title: 66. Cass Timberlane
description: Judge Cass Timberlane marries Virginia Marshland, but after their baby is stillborn, she grows close to his friend Bradd. Though Cass tells her to stay with Bradd during a fight, he brings her home when she falls ill.

Title: 67. The Sin of Harold Diddlebock
description: Harold is a mild-mannered clerk who dreams about marrying the girl at the desk down the aisle. But then he loses his job, and when he is offered a potent drink at a bar, he goes on a very strange and funny rampage (with a lion in tow).

Title: 68. Desire Me
description: Released from a POW camp at the end of WW2, a French soldier tricks the wife of a fellow POW into believing her husband was killed by the Germans and seduces the grieving woman, but the 'dead' husband eventually returns home.

Title: 69. I Became a Criminal
description: After WW2, former RAF airman Clem Morgan joins a gang of black-market smugglers and thieves, but when a robbery goes wrong, Clem is caught, framed for a policeman's murder, and sent to prison, where he plots his escape and revenge.

Title: 70. The Egg and I
description: On their wedding night, Bob reveals to Betty that he has purchased an abandoned chicken farm. Betty struggles to adapt to their new rural lifestyle, especially when a glamorous neighbor seems to set her eyes on Bob.

Title: 71. Repeat Performance
description: On New Year's Eve 1946, Sheila Page kills her husband Barney. She wishes that she could relive 1946 and avoid the mistakes that she made throughout the year. Her wish comes true but cheating fate proves more difficult than she anticipated.

Title: 72. Framed
description: Mike Lambert, seeking a mining job, instead becomes the patsy for a femme-fatale's schemes.

Title: 73. The Fugitive
description: Anti-Catholic and anti-cleric policies in the Mexican state of Tabasco lead the revolutionary government to persecute the state's last remaining priest.

Title: 74. Sinbad, the Sailor
description: In medieval Persia, during the rule of Caliph Harun-Al-Rashid, Sinbad the Sailor boasts about his latest adventures to his friends.

Title: 75. Johnny O'Clock
description: A high-class crook gets in trouble with the law.

Title: 76. The Beginning or the End
description: A docudrama detailing the research, development and deployment of the first atomic bomb, as well as the bombing of Hiroshima.

Title: 77. Ride the Pink Horse
description: WW2 veteran Lucky Gagin arrives in a New Mexico border-town intent on revenging against mobster Frank Hugo but FBI agent Bill Retz, who also wants Hugo, tries to keep Gagin out of trouble.

Title: 78. The October Man
description: When the murder of a young woman happens, her next-door neighbor is under suspicion due to his previous stay in a mental hospital.

Title: 79. T-Men
description: Two U.S. Treasury agents hunt a successful counterfeiting ring.

Title: 80. The Hucksters
description: A World War II veteran wants to return to advertising on his own terms, but finds it difficult to be successful and maintain his integrity.

Title: 81. Green Dolphin Street
description: A young man loved by two sisters becomes a naval officer and sails to New Zealand, where he drunkenly writes a marriage proposal to the wrong sister, profoundly affecting the life of the other.

Title: 82. The Exile
description: Charles II, the King of England, finds himself in exile in Holland, where he falls in love with a beautiful farm-girl.

Title: 83. Monsieur Vincent
description: St. Vincent de Paul struggles to bring about peace and harmony among peasants and nobles in the midst of the Black Death in Europe, carrying on his charitable work in the face of all obstacles.

Title: 84. Cry Wolf
description: Recently widowed Sandra Demarest arrives at the isolated home of her late husband for his wake, but his uncle will not allow her to view the corpse.

Title: 85. Gunfighters
description: Gunfighter Brazos Kane takes a job on a ranch but he is unjustly accused of killing fellow cowhand Bob Tyrell and must clear himself by finding the real killer.

Title: 86. The Guilty
description: Two guys sharing an apartment meet twin girls (both Bonita Granville). One's sweet, the other a major piece of bad news. The nice one is murdered and her boyfriend is accused of the crime. The wrong man/wrong victim plot strikes again.

Title: 87. The Pearl
description: The discovery of a perfect pearl forever changes the lives of a poor Mexican fisherman and his family.

Title: 88. Ivy
description: An Edwardian belle meets a rich bachelor, but what to do about her husband and her lover?

Title: 89. The Macomber Affair
description: In British East Africa, a fatal triangle develops involving a frustrated wife, a weak and cowardly husband, and an English big-game hunter who comes between the couple.

Title: 90. Variety Girl
description: Almost everyone under contract to Paramount Pictures at the time make cameos or perform songs, with particularly large amounts of screen time featuring Bob Hope and Bing Crosby.

Title: 91. Ramrod
description: Story about violent feud between Connie Dickason, the owner of the Circle 66 ranch and rancher Frank Ivey, the self-proclaimed boss of an otherwise public grazing land.

Title: 92. Mourning Becomes Electra
description: Eugene O'Neill's updated version of the Oresteia set in New England, after the American Civil War.

Title: 93. Railroaded!
description: A beautician and her crooked boyfriend attempt to rob the bookie operation located in the back room, but when the plan goes wrong, they frame an innocent man.

Title: 94. It Happened in Brooklyn
description: Soldier Danny Miller returns home to Brooklyn after war. Aiming for singing success, he helps friends chasing dreams.

Title: 95. The Lost Moment
description: A publisher insinuates himself into the mouldering mansion of the centenarian lover of a renowned but long-dead poet to find his lost love letters.

Title: 96. Dear Murderer
description: A businessman plans to kill his cheating wife's lover and make it look like suicide.

Title: 97. Out of the Blue
description: Timid Arthur panics after mistaking the tipsy Olive for dead and dumps her on artist Galleo's terrace. Sensing an opportunity, Galleo tries to blackmail him but chaos unfolds when Olive refuses to stay dead.

Title: 98. Deep Valley
description: A girl living with her parents on an isolated California farm falls in love with a chain-gang convict working at a nearby highway construction site, and sets out to help him when he escapes.

Title: 99. The Brasher Doubloon
description: Detective Philip Marlowe encounters a variety of characters while checking on why Leslie Murdock stole a rare doubloon from his mother.

Title: 100. Daisy Kenyon
description: A commercial artist having an affair with a married attorney becomes involved with a returning soldier and must choose between the two.

Title: 101. Code of Scotland Yard
description: In Britain, a man with a shady past uses his antiquities shop as a front for smuggled diamonds but his young shop-assistant starts blackmailing him, leading to murder and to a police investigation.

Title: 102. Honeymoon
description: A prospective bride and groom have misadventures in Mexico City.

Title: 103. Smash-Up: The Story of a Woman
description: A successful nightclub singer weds a struggling songwriter, but when his fame eclipses hers, she delves into alcoholism.

Title: 104. Desperate
description: A young married couple flee both the police and a gangster out for revenge.

Title: 105. Banjo
description: A 9-year-old Georgia girl and her dog are sent to live with her aunt in Boston.

Title: 106. Los tres García
description: Ruled by a tough grandma (Sara García), the Garcías (Infante, Salazar and Mendoza) are three charro cousins who fall in love with young American-born Lupita (Marga López) and fight for her love until grandma quiets them.

Title: 107. ¡A volar joven!
description: A wealthy couple marries their "unattractive" daughter to one of their farmhands, who ultimately becomes a celebrated aviator.

Title: 108. Road to Rio
description: Two inept vaudevillians stow away on a Brazilian-bound ocean liner and foil a plot by a sinister hypnotist to marry off her niece to a greedy fortune hunter.

Title: 109. The Woman on the Beach
description: A Coast Guardsman suffering from Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder becomes involved with a beautiful and enigmatic seductress married to a blind painter.

Title: 110. The Life and Adventures of Nicholas Nickleby
description: A young, compassionate man struggles to save his family and friends from the abusive exploitation of his cold-hearted, grasping uncle.

Title: 111. Saigon
description: After WW2, two army buddies, one of them terminally-ill, embark on a series of adventures in South-East Asia and run across a dangerous criminal and his pretty secretary.

Title: 112. The Unfaithful
description: A Los Angeles socialite kills a man while home alone one night and claims he was an intruder she did not know. It seems like a clear case of self defense until the story hits the papers and people connected to the dead man come forward.

Title: 113. The Flame
description: A woman falls for the victim of an intended blackmail plot.

Title: 114. Cheyenne
description: To avoid going to trial, a gambler becomes a detective for an insurance company to find out who is robbing the stages.

Title: 115. Dreams That Money Can Buy
description: After learning how to look inside himself, a poetic bum sells people vivid dreams.

Title: 116. Night Song
description: When a beautiful socialite falls in love with an embittered composer who is blind, she feigns blindness herself in order to get closer to him.

Title: 117. Mr. District Attorney
description: An assistant district attorney gets mixed-up with a woman who is working for the group that he is investigating.

Title: 118. One Wonderful Sunday
description: During a Sunday trip into war-ravaged Tokyo, despairing Yuzo and optimistic Masako look for work and lodging, as well as affordable entertainments to pass the time.

Title: 119. An Ideal Husband
description: A politician plans to expose a financial scandal, but an investor threatens to reveal his past secret if he does. His unforgiving wife adds to his dilemma of navigating the scandal and potential exposure.

Title: 120. California
description: Epic account of how California became a state, featuring a wagon train, the Gold Rush, a wicked saloon queen, and an evil profiteer.

Title: 121. The Senator Was Indiscreet
description: A bumbling, long-winded and crooked Southern senator, considered by some as a dark horse for the Presidency, panics his party when his tell-all diary is stolen.

Title: 122. The Other Love
description: Karen Duncan, a seriously ill concert pianist, enters a Swiss sanatorium where she's attracted to Dr. Tony Stanton. Ignoring his warnings about resting, she leaves for Monte Carlo with Paul Clermont despite possibly fatal consequences.

Title: 123. Dangerous Years
description: A youth counselor is killed by the leader of a teen gang during a warehouse robbery, and the prosecuting district attorney is determined to see justice done.

Title: 124. The Perils of Pauline
description: The real life story of actress Pearl White during her rise to fame in silent serials.

Title: 125. Three on a Ticket
description: A private detective, who has been shot, stumbles into the office of Michael Shayne (Hugh Beaumont), and dies before Shayne can question him. Shayne finds a baggage ticket in his hand. He claims it and finds the checked-bag contains the loot from a robbery. Now, he has about fifty minutes left of the running time to find the crooks, bring them to justice and return the money to the rightful owners. And needs all of it.

Title: 126. West to Glory
description: A western sheriff chases a gang trying to rob a rancher's gold.

Title: 127. Magic Town
description: An opinion pollster finds a town which is a perfect mirror of U.S. opinions.

Title: 128. The Corpse Came C.O.D.
description: After a dead body turns up in the home of a famous actress, two reporters (who also happen to be in love with one another) compete to get the real scoop.

Title: 129. Fiesta
description: When a matador leaves town to focus on his music, his twin sister takes on his identity in the bullfighting ring.

Title: 130. A Ship to India
description: A sailor returns to his hometown after 7 years and remembers the dark and the light moments of his past.

Title: 131. Trail Street
description: Bat Masterson's old friend Billy Burns convinces him to become marshal of Liberal, Kansas and help the residents fight drought and a destructive range war.

Title: 132. Dick Tracy Meets Gruesome
description: Dick Tracy goes up against a villain who robs banks using a nerve gas.

Title: 133. The Late George Apley
description: George and Catherine Apley, a Boston family, live a proper life in a social circle. However, Eleanor's love for Howard and John's union with Myrtle threatens their home.

Title: 134. Take My Life
description: Philippa Shelley races against time to clear her husband Nicholas Talbot of a murder he did not commit. While she works on getting proof, the prosecution is doing all it can to force a conviction.

Title: 135. Singapore
description: After WW2, an American skipper returns to Singapore to retrieve his hidden stash of pearls and finds his lost fiancée who now has amnesia.

Title: 136. The Romance of Rosy Ridge
description: In post-Civil War Missouri, friends, relatives and neighbors find it difficult to live harmoniously together knowing that some of them fought on opposing sides during the war.

Title: 137. It Had to Be You
description: A woman is noted for leaving her bridegrooms at the altar until a dashing fireman walks into her life.

Title: 138. The Voice of the Turtle
description: A soldier spends the weekend with an actress after being stood up by her friend. Will he be able to change her cynical attitude towards love?

Title: 139. Boyka
description: Boyka and Hristo are in love and they pledge to marry. Yovcho, the older brother of Hristo, is against. The nasty Stoyko also likes Boyka. Stoyko's matchmakers arrive and take Boyka away in a cart. At the same time Hristo together with some friends manage to free her. Hristo's father is keen on building a new house and wants to give some land to the newly-weds. But the rumor spreads around the village - the child which Boyka is expecting may not be Hristo's; didn't she spend a whole night at the Stoyko's house? Hristo begins to worry. When he speaks to his wife about his torments she is horrified. They have a quarrel and Boyka goes out. The drunken Stoyko admitted that he spread the rumor. Everyone goes out to look for Boyka. Soon they find her drowned in the millpond.

Title: 140. Temptation Harbor
description: A signalman on a quay sees a fight between two men. One of the men is deliberately pushed into the water and the signalman cannot save him, but decides to keep his suitcase which he later finds is full of banknotes with a value of £5000.

Title: 141. Mother Wore Tights
description: In a vaudeville family's story, Myrtle McKinley joins a chorus line instead of business school. Actor Frank Burt hires and marries her.

Title: 142. The Upturned Glass
description: A British brain surgeon punishes his lover's killer..

Title: 143. Tarzan and the Huntress
description: To equip the American zoos with as many animals as possible, a cruel trio of big game hunters team up with an unexpected ally, threatening the African fauna. Will Tarzan allow the fiendish huntress to pillage the jungle?

Title: 144. Copacabana
description: An agent has his only client pose as both a French chanteuse and Brazilian bombshell to fool a nightclub owner.

Title: 145. Dear Ruth
description: A family is befuddled when a World War II serviceman shows up to meet and marry his pen pal sweetheart. Everyone's in the dark about the romance by mail. Then they discover Ruth's younger sister was the culprit.

Title: 146. Buck Privates Come Home
description: Two World War II veterans return from overseas--one of them having smuggled into the country a French orphan girl he has become attached to. They wind up running into their old sergeant--who hates them--and getting involved with a race-car builder who's trying to find backers for a new midget racer he's building.

Title: 147. The Gangster
description: Shubunka (Barry Sulivan) is a cynical gangster who controls the Neptune Beach waterfront. He runs a numbers racket with the local soda shop owner. The police are in his pocket and the local hoods are on his payroll.

Title: 148. The Shocking Miss Pilgrim
description: In the late 1800s, Miss Pilgrim, a young typist, becomes the first female employee at a Boston shipping office. Although the men object to her at first, she soon charms them all, especially the handsome young head of the company. Their romance gets sidetracked when she becomes involved in the women's suffrage movement.

Title: 149. Slave Girl
description: An American adventurer goes to Tripoli to rescue some kidnapped sailors, but gets involved with a beautiful slave girl.

Title: 150. Koskenkylän laulu
description: The son of a farmer works as a lumberjack and falls in love with a beautiful but poor girl, who lives near the rapids in the Finnish countryside. The film contains love, romance, jealousy, fights, and is typical of Finnish film of the '40s.

Title: 151. Riffraff
description: After a man disappears from a flight with valuable oil maps, fixer Dan Hammer gets involved in a tropical mystery filled with intrigue and uncertain allies.

Title: 152. Gunsmoke
description: Rancher Marlowe is killed by Dirk Mattson. His son Brad seeks revenge, kills Dirk, and is wounded. Carol Henderson finds Brad and gets outlaws to help him. Brad joins Duke's Raiders, led by Dirk's twin, to take down the gang from within.

Title: 153. Master Detective Blomkvist
description: It's summer. Kalle, Eva-Lotta and Anders have formed a gang, the White Rose. They are in playful battle with Red Rose gang. A relative of Eva-Lotta's mother, Uncle Einar, come to visit and Kalle notice immediately that he is behaving strangely. Einar seems to have hidden something in a closed mine outside town. Two mysterious strangers appear.

Title: 154. The Damned
description: In the last days of World War II, a group of Nazis and their sympathizers try to escape from reckoning using a submarine.

Title: 155. Time Out of Mind
description: The son of a wealthy Maine shipping magnate causes a crisis in the family when he announces that he wants a career in music rather than in the family business.

Title: 156. Golden Earrings
description: On the eve of WW2, a British spy goes to Germany to obtain a secret poison-gas formula from a scientist but things go awry and he is saved by a beautiful nomadic gypsy woman.

Title: 157. The Fabulous Joe
description: The adventures of a talking dog, Joe, who advises henpecked Milo Terkel to muster the courage to confront his dominating wife Emily and assorted in-laws while tackling a buxom blonde who just happens to undress in the Terkels' apartment.

Title: 158. The Guilt of Janet Ames
description: A bitter war widow meets a soldier her husband died saving. As he defends the sacrifice's value and battles alcoholism, she struggles with complex grief while they help each other heal.

Title: 159. Exposed
description: A beautiful female private detective is hired by a wealthy businessman to check up on his stepson--the heir to the family fortune--who has been withdrawing large amounts of money from his bank account.

Title: 160. This Time for Keeps
description: Expected to follow his opera star father into the business, but discontent with his life, a young man pursues a career in popular music and romances the aquatic ballet dancer he met during his time in the service.

Title: 161. The Foxes of Harrow
description: In pre-Civil War New Orleans, Louisiana, roguish Irish gambler Stephen Fox (Sir Rex Harrison) buys his way into society, something he couldn't do in his homeland because he is illegitimate.

Title: 162. Adventure Island
description: Travelers find themselves marooned on an island with a maniacal self-made ruler.

Title: 163. Frieda
description: A Royal Air Force pilot who was shot down during World War II returns home to his English village with his new bride. The trouble is that she is the German lady who helped him escape. Then her brother arrives.

Title: 164. So Well Remembered
description: Mayor George Boswell recalls events of the previous 25 years in his home town of Browdley. As councilman and newspaper editor George has fought hard to better working and living conditions in the bleak Lancashire mill town.

Title: 165. The Private Affairs of Bel Ami
description: In 1880, in Paris, chance brought together two former comrades-in-arms - Charles Forestier, who had become a journalist for "La Vie française" - and Georges Duroy, idle since leaving the sixth regiment of hussars.

Title: 166. Record of a Tenement Gentleman
description: In postwar Japan, an abandoned boy nobody wants to take care of grows a relationship with a cynical middle-aged widow.

Title: 167. The Inheritance
description: Following her father's death, a teenage British heiress goes to live with her guardian uncle--who is broke and schemes to murder her for her inheritance.

Title: 168. Non coupable
description: An alcoholic doctor accidentally kills someone and manages to make the death look like an accident. The episode triggers a sense of confidence and he resolves to correct the miseries of his life.

Title: 169. Mine Own Executioner
description: Molly seeks psychologist Felix's help for her dangerous husband Adam, a traumatized former prisoner nearing schizophrenia. Felix's attempts to assist Adam worsen his own troubled home life, leading to a tense climax.

Title: 170. Always Together
description: Millionaire Turner bequeaths $1M to movie buff Jane, who marries Donn concealing the inheritance. Turner recovers, wanting his money back, straining the newlyweds. Jane visualizes her life as a movie starring real actors.

Title: 171. La diosa arrodillada
description: An artist's model leads the ever-hapless Arturo de Córdova away from the arms of his innocent, blue-eyed wife and down, down, down into the ecstatic depths of degradation, including a stop at a seedy Panama nightclub.

Title: 172. Devil in the Flesh
description: During World War I, the star-crossed affair of an underage French student with a woman engaged to a soldier.

Title: 173. Dancing with Crime
description: A London cab driver gets mixed up with a criminal gang and sets out to expose the group and its leader for what they are.

Title: 174. The Hunchback Horse
description: Adventures of Ivan the Fool and humpbacked horse in the world of kind magical creatures and cruel people.

Title: 175. Bury Me Dead
description: Barbara finds herself at her own funeral, believing Rod plotted her death. The deceased is actually Helen Lawrence, Rod's lover. Her fake sister Rusty, boxer George Mandley, and lawyer Michael Dunn are involved.

Title: 176. Don Quijote de la Mancha
description: The most faithful of all the major film versions of Cervantes' novel.

Title: 177. Escape Me Never
description: Errol Flynn stars as Sebastian Dubrok, a penniless composer who marries a young widow with a baby son, although he is in love with his brother's fiancée.

Title: 178. Jassy
description: Jassy, a 17th-century English girl with prophetic visions, is accused of witchcraft. Barney Hatton, whose father gambled away their home, aids her. Grateful, Jassy vows to help Barney reclaim his property, regardless of the consequences.

Title: 179. Flesh Will Surrender
description: Giovanni used to be a humble, mild-mannered government clerk, but his life was turned upside-down when he met Giulio. a notorious forger who at once set about manipulating the overconfident man. Giovanni did what he never should have: associated himself with the crook. Giulio soon got hold of Giovanni's money, ruined his career, and manhandled him into marrying his own mistress, the beautiful Ginevra. The marriage was unhappy, but Giovanni found a little solace when his son Ciro was born. Seven years later, Giulio returns.

Title: 181. Christmas Eve
description: To save her fortune from a designing nephew, Matilda Reed must locate her three long-lost adopted sons in time for a Christmas Eve reunion.

Title: 182. Seven Keys to Baldpate
description: A mystery writer gets caught up in a real mystery when he accepts a bet to write a book at Baldpate, a remote inn.

Title: 183. Driftwood
description: 6-year-old Jenny rescues a collie dog slated for animal experiments. Dr. Webster adopts them both, to his fiancee's chagrin. An outbreak of spotted fever sends the town into panic and Jenny is infected and about to die.

Title: 184. For You I Die
description: Convict Johnny is forced to participate in a prison break by fellow inmate Matt. They escape and separate. Johnny falls for waitress Hope and hides in a roadhouse where he thwarts a hold-up. But soon Matt shows up - ready to use his gun.

Title: 185. It Happened in Europe
description: A band of runaways and orphans of the war scour the countryside in search of food and shelter. They invade and then taken in by a musician and former concert pianist who's hiding out in a ruined castle. After the initial altercation between them the gang accepts his guidance and he wins their respect by protecting them from the elements. However, disgruntled townsfolk want to chase away the gang who has been - in their search for survival - laying waste to their crops. A battle ensues ending in the death of a little boy - and resolution.

Title: 186. Snow Trail
description: Three bank robbers on the run from the police hide out in a remote mountain lodge high up in the snowy Japanese Alps.

Title: 187. Welcome Stranger
description: The old-time town doctor of Fallbridge plans his first vacation in 30 years. But his dislike of, and frequent squabbles with his young interim replacement may jeopardize more than his vacation.

Title: 188. The Chinese Ring
description: Soon after a Chinese princess comes to the US to buy planes for her people, she is murdered by a poison dart fired by an air rifle.

Title: 189. Love from a Stranger
description: A newly married woman begins to suspect that her husband is a killer. Even worse, she soon comes to believe that she will be his next victim.

Title: 190. Philo Vance Returns
description: Playboy Larry Blendon (Damian O'Flynn) introduces his grandmother Stella Blendon (Clara Blandick) to his fiancee, radio singer Virginia Berneaux (Ramsay Ames). Despite Larry's record of broken romances and divorces, Virginia decides she will marry him. Virginia is slain that night and Blandon telephones his friend Philo Vance (William Wright) to help find the killer. Even as they talk, the killer strikes again and Philo hears Larry fall dead. Philo begins his investigation with Alexis Karnoff (Leon Belasco), Virginia's manager, and the two go to Larry's home, where Stella tells them that the motive for the killing might be Larry's will that names the six women in his life as heirs and if any die before the will is probated, the others will divide the shares. They also learn that Katherine Corbett (Phyllis Planchard), the first of Larry's wives, has been murdered. Suspicion now falls on Lorena Sims (Vivian Austin), a former wife who has been a patient at a sanitarium suffering from a nervous ailment. All of the deaths have been by poison and Lorena had access to it at the sanitarium. Philo uncovers another piece of information that leads him to break into the Blandon home just as Stella is about to give Lorena a glass of warm milk.

Title: 191. That Hagen Girl
description: Mary Hagen lives in a small town in Ohio and goes to Jordon Junior College. For years, there have been whispers, rumors and gossip about who her real parents are. After Tom Bates returns to town, he takes over the house and practice that Judge Merrivale left him following his death. As Tom has been away a number of years, this leads to more gossip and Mary believes that he is her father. The popular and rich Ken loves Mary, but his family and friends constantly remind him that she is 'not one of us'. Julia, a teacher at school encourages Mary but Mary cannot get a break in anything she does, or is accused of doing. Tom knows the answer to her true identity, and he is silent.

Title: 192. Intrigue
description: In post-war China, a court-martialed pilot flies smuggled goods into the country, but soon finds his mindset challenged when he becomes friends with a social worker who disapproves of his actions.

Title: 193. Passionnelle
description: Julien, a modest postal worker, admires and hopelessly loves Thérèse, the lovely daughter of the local squire. But, quite unexpectedly, on the very night of her engagement with Count of Vétheuil, Thérèse asks Julien for help. In fact, she has just killed Pierre, her lover and wants his body disposed of. Julien performs the sinister task and is entitled to a night of love with Thérèse. Then he disappears. When Thérèse, ashamed, wants to confess, nobody believes her. Julien, who had come to denounce her, cannot speak when he finds himself facing the girl who had bewitched him and still does, and is arrested.

Title: 194. The Devil Thumbs a Ride
description: Law-abiding Jimmy Ferguson soon regrets giving a ride to killer Steve Morgan.

Title: 195. New Orleans
description: A gambling hall owner relocates from New Orleans to Chicago and entertains his patrons with hot jazz by Louis Armstrong, Billie Holiday, Woody Herman, and others.

Title: 196. Shoot to Kill
description: A woman apparently marries a corrupt deputy D.A. to get evidence that a certain criminal was framed for murder.

Title: 197. Woman of Evil
description: On a small island in the middle of the river where Tramontana almost always blows, some losers tear each other to pieces .

Title: 198. Holiday Camp
description: The Huggett family go to a holiday camp, and get involved in crooked card players, a murderer on the run, and a pregnant young girl and her boyfriend missing from home.

Title: 199. Man About Town
description: 1910. A friend leaves his daughter, Madeleine, with Emile a French film producer. Emile falls in love with her. Problems starts when his young friend Jacques returns from military service complaining his misfortune with women. Once he follows Emile's advice to have an affair, he meets Lucette and falls in love with her instead.

Title: 200. The Loves of Joanna Godden
description: On Romney Marsh at the turn of the century, a woman farmer has three suitors.

Title: 201. Carnival in Costa Rica
description: Two pairs of lovers try to thwart an arranged marriage at Costa Rican fiesta time.

Title: 202. The Thirteenth Hour
description: Truck owner Steve Reynolds gets caught up in a rivalry feud and is framed for a cop's murder after his truck is stolen. With a diamond-studded glove as the only clue, he evades the law while pursuing the real culprit to clear his name.

Title: 203. Lighthouse
description: Two lighthouse keepers' routine is disrupted when the assistant's girlfriend learns unflattering truths about him from his boss. She spitefully marries the older keeper instead, creating tension as all three must live together.

Title: 204. Tragic Hunt
description: Immediately after the war, bandits attack a truck that is transporting newlyweds Michele and Giovanna and the accountant of an agricultural cooperative charged with bringing four million lire into office.

Title: 205. Bush Christmas
description: In Australia, five children pursue horse thieves through the mountains.

Title: 206. The Fabulous Dorseys
description: The Dorsey Brothers bandleaders' lives traced from childhood music insisting father to fame rise eventual split furthering careers propelling with their music.

Title: 207. Key Witness
description: Milton Higby, an inventor of gadgets that don't sell finds himself accused of a crime he didn't commit---the killing of a girl he had just met---, and takes to the open road with the police in close pursuit. In his travels, he stumbles across the body of another murder victim and switches identities with the corpse. With his new name he poses as the long-lost son of a wealthy industrialist until he is exposed and charged also with the second murder.

Title: 208. Killer Dill
description: Lingerie salesman Johnny Dill, thought to be a killer gangster, finds himself struck between the forces of good and evil.

Title: 209. O Leão da Estrela
description: Anastácio lives in Lisbon and is fanatic for Sporting, one of the city's football teams. When the team travels to face Porto, he follows it with the family, staying in house of his friend, Mr. Barata, pretending to be rich.

Title: 210. Les jeux sont faits
description: Two people learn to love each other in the afterlife and get a second chance.

Title: 211. Hungry Hill
description: Story of a feud that has gone on between two Irish families for more than 50 years.

Title: 212. Brick Bradford
description: Brick Bradford, well-known soldier of fortune, is hired to protect the Interceptor Ray, an anti-guided missile weapon. His task takes him flying to the moon where he is captured by subjects of Queen Khana and condemned to death.

Title: 213. Captain Boycott
description: In 1880 Ireland, poor farmers rebel against the abuses of their British landlords.

Title: 214. Philo Vance's Secret Mission
description: Publisher Martin Jamison sends for Philo Vance as he wants to hire him as a technical advisor on the crime stories he publishes. Paul Morgan, Jamison's partner, regards the plan as foolish. Jamison tells his secretary Mona Bannister to bring Vance to his home that night and he will reveal the solution to the seven-year mystery of the killing of Haddon Phillips, former partner in the firm. Phillips ex-wife, now a receptionist for the company, is alarmed when she overhears. As Vance and Mona drive up, two shots are heard and Jamison's body is later found in the trunk of Vance's car.

Title: 215. Wild Harvest
description: Joe is the head of an itinerant combine crew, working the harvests against rival crew boss Alperson. Joe's buddy Jim joins the crew with startup money. Farmer's niece Fay falls for Joe. He puts her off. To get back she marries Jim whom she prods into high-grading the grain (skimming off some for private sale). The last payment on Joe's machinery is due just as he discover's what his buddy has been doing.

Title: 216. The Spring River Flows East
description: 1930's China. The village of a poor family is taken over by the occupying Japanese army. One son, Zhongliang, leaves his wife and young son to join a medic group for the Chinese Army. The other son, Zhangmin goes into hiding to protect his family. The focus shifts back and forth from the brothers' parents and Zhongliang's wife and son to Zhongliang's newfound life of luxury in a town not too far away. The plight of Zhongliang's mother, his wife, Sufan and her son, Kongeson is contrasted with Zhongliang's rise in a flourishing company.

Title: 217. Her Husband's Affairs
description: A scientist invents a formula that removes old, thinning hair and replaces it with thick new hair. Complications ensue.

Title: 218. Wyoming
description: Small ranchers battle against a land baron trying to take their spreads.

Title: 219. Design for Death
description: An Academy Award winner for best documentary, the film opens with a notice that..."Exhibition of confiscated Japanese film material authorized by permission of the Alien Property Custodian in the public interest under License No. LM 979"...and was assembled from hundreds of captured newsreels, historical dramas and propaganda films. While revealing the steps that Japan took that led to Pearl Harbor, it goes back 700 years to the feudal caste system, a peasant revolt suppressed after the Samurai murdered over 40,000 people, to Admiral Perry forcibly opening Japan to foreign trade, to the perversion of converting the Shinto religion of nature-worship to that of a fanatic state creed that preached the Japanese were a Master Race and the Emperor was a sun-god to be blindly obeyed. The film carried no credit for a director, while Richard Fleischer shared the Producer credit with Theron Warth.

Title: 220. That Way with Women
description: A bored automobile industry tycoon assumes a false identity, buys a half interest in a gas station, and plays matchmaker for his daughter.

Title: 221. Killer McCoy
description: Following a mishap in the ring, hard-nosed lightweight Tommy "Killer" McCoy gets mixed up with a big time gambler and falls for his educated daughter Sheila, against her father's better wishes.

Title: 222. Blonde Savage
description: An expedition into the deep jungle discovers a native tribe led by a tall white blonde woman.

Title: 223. The Wistful Widow of Wagon Gap
description: Chester Wooley (Lou Costello) and Duke Egan (Bud Abbott) are traveling salesmen who make a stopover in Wagon Gap, Montana en route to California. During the stopover, notorious criminal Fred Hawkins is murdered and the two are charged with the crime. They are quickly tried, convicted, and sentenced to die by hanging. The head of the local citizens' committee, Jim Simpson (William Ching), recalls a law whereby the survivor of a gun duel must take responsibility for the deceased's debts and family. The law spares the two from execution, but Chester is now responsible for the widow Hawkins (Marjorie Main) and her seven children. They go to her farm, where she works Chester from dawn to dusk, and at night he must work at the saloon to repay Hawkins' debt to its owner, Jake Frame (Gordon Jones). Her plan is to wear Chester down until he agrees to marry her. Chester quickly learns that no one will harm him, for fear that they will need to support Mrs. Hawkins and her family. Simpson makes Chester the sheriff hoping that fear of him will help clean up the lawless town. For protection, Chester carries around a photograph of Mrs. Hawkins and her kids. The approach works for a while, and Chester is heralded as a hero. Meanwhile, Duke still plans to go to California and tries to get Judge Benbow (George Cleveland) to marry Mrs. Hawkins to free him and Chester from their obligations. He starts a rumor that Mrs. Hawkins is about to become rich once the railroad buys her land to lay tracks. The rumor spreads quickly, and everyone tries to kill Chester hoping to marry Mrs. Hawkins(and share, or manage, her expected fortune). Frame eventually confesses to Hawkins' murder; Duke and Chester are cleared and allowed to leave town, but not before they admit that they fabricated the railroad rumor. Benbow still wants to marry Mrs. Hawkins, and she agrees. She then announces that the railroad actually did offer her substantial money, and she is now wealthy.

Title: 224. Whispering City
description: When a nagging wife commits suicide, her husband is threatened with a murder frame by his lawyer, unless he kills a certain female reporter for him.

Title: 225. Backlash
description: Detectives try to solve the case of a murdered Los Angeles defense attorney.

Title: 226. The Vigilante: Fighting Hero of the West
description: The Vigilante, a masked government agent, is assigned to investigate the case of the "100 Tears of Blood," a cursed string of rare blood red pearls sought by a gang led by the unknown X-1 that may have been smuggled into the country.

Title: 227. Too Many Winners
description: Michael Shayne accepts an assignment to investigate a gang of pari-mutual race tickets counterfeiters over the protests of his secretary, Phyllis Hamilton, who wants him to join her on a vacation. Shayne contacts Mayme Martin who offers him information, and sends his friend Tim Rourke to get it. Tim arrives to find Inspector Rafferty there as Mayme has been murdered. Shayne has gone to the race track to see Jim Payson and Al Hardeman, the operators. Two thugs, Joe and Punk, take shots at Shayne and he is wounded. He later learns that a printer, Madden and his engraving foreman Edwards served time for counterfeiting Irish sweepstake tickets and Shayne thinks he has the case solved... until Madden and Edwards turn up murdered.

Title: 228. High Tide
description: A PI and editor crash their car on a Malibu highway. Trapped, the editor reveals his boss was killed by gangsters. The PI, hired to avenge the editor, is caught between his old flame Julie and new love Dana as suspects emerge.

Title: 229. The Pretender
description: Banker Kenneth Holden embezzles from an estate and schemes to marry the heiress, Claire Worthington, to cover it up. He arranges for her fiancé to be killed so he can marry Claire - but the hired killer is now stalking Holden.

Title: 230. Rustlers of Devil's Canyon
description: Red Ryder returns from the Spanish American war to find rustlers in control. When homesteaders arrive, they start a fight between them and the ranchers. Red tries to solve the problem not knowing a trusted friend is the leader of the rustlers and knows of Red's plans.

Title: 231. Unexpected Guest
description: At the reading of his late cousin's will, California learns the estate will be divied among whoever remains of the seven relatives. With one already dead, another immediately murdered, and the Lawyer telling them the ranch is almost worthless, Hoppy investigates. Finding the ranch valuable and the Lawyer embezzling money from it, Hoppy confronts him.

Title: 232. ¡Vuelven los García!
description: Luis Antonio, Jose Luis and Luis Manuel are back and seemingly at ease with each other. However, destiny still has something in store for them: the spawn of one of the evil Lopez, siblings Leon and Juan Simon, are looking for vengeance.

Title: 233. Roses Are Red
description: A paroled convict who bears a striking resemblance to the local District Attorney is hired by the mob to impersonate him, while the real District Attorney is kidnapped and held captive at a secret location.

Title: 234. The Mark of Cain
description: An attractive young French girl instigates rivalry between two brothers when she becomes the bride of the younger one.

Title: 235. Wild Country
description: Eddie and Soapy have to find a man who broke out of prison.

Title: 236. Kilroy Was Here
description: "Kilroy Was Here" was a popular expression during World War II, but it's not much fun to John J. Kilroy, who has to try to live with all the jokes and wisecracks regarding his name.

Title: 237. The Invisible Wall
description: When a mob boss sends gambler Harry Lane to Vegas to deliver 20K to a contact, Harry gambles the money away and must somehow recover it before getting into trouble with his employer.

Title: 238. Black Gold
description: In the 1920s Texas, Indian farmer Charley Eagle is dreaming of winning the Kentucky Derby with his Black Hope horse but things change when oil is found on his land and the Black Gold colt is born.

Title: 239. My Wild Irish Rose
description: The life of Irish tenor Chauncey Olcott is chronicled from his childhood to his days as the toast of New York. In between, his rise to the top is complicated by romances with two women: his true love Rose Donovan and stage star Lillian Russell, who wants to make him a star.

Title: 240. It's a Joke, Son!
description: When the Daughters of Dixie nominate a candidate for State Senator, the local political machine run by Northerners fears its candidate will be defeated, and chooses her husband as a candidate in order to split the anti-machine vote.

Title: 241. Fantômas
description: The invincible bandit faces his daughter, who wants him to end his criminal activities.

Title: 242. Dick Tracy's Dilemma
description: Dick Tracy investigates the theft of a fortune of fur coats, a possible insurance swindle and several murders, all linked to a huge thug who wears a hook in place of his right hand.

Title: 243. Bad Sister
description: In a home for delinquent girls, the worst offender exchanges reminiscences with the warden.

Title: 244. The Black Widow
description: The Daily Clarion hires detective story writer Steve Colt to investigate the deaths of a group of scientists working on an atomic rocket development project. Behind the killings is fortune teller Sombra, a spy from an Asian country intent on world domination, who is determined to pilfer the atomic rocket by luring workers from the project to her parlor and killing them with black widow spider venom when they refuse to cooperate.

Title: 245. Copie conforme
description: A smooth criminal, who turns to be Manuel Ismora, and his gang successfully and peacefully pull off con after heist. Elsewhere a timid office worker, Gabriel Dupon, is pressured by his boss into making a sale. A chain of events causes him to get mixed up with the criminal, and get arrested. Lack of evidence ensures Dupon's release, but brings him to the attention of the criminal who persuades him into cooperation. Ismora exploits the fact that Dupon looks so much like him that they could be - carbon copies.

Title: 246. Linda, Be Good
description: Linda Prentiss joins a burlesque troupe to get information for a novel she is writing without her husband, Roger Prentiss, knowing about it. Not knowing who he is, she meets her husband's boss, Sam Thompson, while on a night-clubbing tour with the show's burlesque queen Margie LaVitte. Later, the boss takes a client and Roger to the burlesque show, and Roger is stunned to see his wife as one of the stars.

Title: 247. The Wild Frontier
description: Outlaws are in control of the land so the town of Clayton City writes the governor for an honest marshal. That marshal is Frank Lane, who brings his son Rocky with him. They are attacked on the way to town by bandits, but Jimmy arrives in time to drive them off. In town, Marshal Lane figures that Saddles is the man behind the outlaw gang, but Saddles kills Lane before he can jail him. With no witnesses, they blame Nugget for the killing and Jimmy is gunning for him. Rocky decides to use the insurance money as bait to smoke out the outlaws and the head man.

Title: 248. Living in a Big Way
description: Leo Gogarty marries Margaud Morgan after a whirlwind romance just before shipping out to war. Upon his return, he is surprised to discover that his bride is not what she led him to believe, but also that she expects a quick divorce. Both Mr. and Mrs. Gogarty must find their place with or without each other in a society still adjusting to peace.

Title: 249. The Devil on Wheels
description: A teenager involved in running from the police in his hot rod hits a car in a hit-and-run case where the victims turn out to be his mother and his best friend in another hot rod.

Title: 250. My Father's House
description: A boy who survived the Holocaust hopes to be reunited with his parents in the Holy Land.

Title: 251. Circus Boy
description: An excellent swimmer, Michael Scott is chosen to represent his school at a swimming competition but his nerves unfortunately fail him and he does not stand on the podium. His parents try to comfort him but in vain. His mother, a former circus artist, then urges him to accept an invitation to spend a month at the big top where she once worked. Mrs Prada, Mrs. Scott's former partner, has indeed invited the boy to join her and her two children and to share their lives during this time. Michael finally accepts and soon makes friends with Florence and George. Brother and sister are currently training for a funambulist act. Interested in their specialty, Michel starts learning how to walk on a tightrope too.

Title: 252. That's My Man
description: A poor young man is finally able to achieve his dream of running a horse at the track, but when he starts becoming successful, he begins to lose sight of what mattered to him before.

Title: 253. Sepia Cinderella
description: A struggling songwriter (Billy Daniels) abandons his girlfriend (Sheila Guyse) for a flashy woman (Tondeleyo) after landing a hit.

Title: 254. A Man About the House
description: Two poor sisters inherit a giant villa from their uncle, along with his custodian Salvatore who charms his way into their lives and marries one of them.

Title: 255. La maison sous la mer
description: A stranger named Constant, disrupts life of Flora who is seemingly happy with her husband, Lucien. She suddenly experiences a passionate love, taking refuge with her lover in a cave they call "home under the sea."

Title: 256. Hard Boiled Mahoney
description: Mistaken for a detective, Slip takes on the case of a missing woman, which turns out to be bogus.

Title: 257. The Czech Year
description: Puppet animation feature consisting of different segments related to the traditions and emotions of the seasons as a typical year passes among the Czech people.

Title: 259. Dragnet
description: Wilcoxon, a Scotland Yard inspector, travels to New York to investigate the activities of an international band of jewel thieves.

Title: 260. Heartaches
description: Up-and-coming Hollywood actor/crooner, Vic Morton, has a secret. He starts receiving death threats in the mail and an attempt on his life is made. Soon after, two of his associates are murdered. Who is behind it all?

Title: 261. The Hills of Donegal
description: An Irish singer marries the wrong man.

Title: 262. Gran Casino
description: A prison escapee becomes involved with an independent oil well owner threatened by corporate thugs, who do their dodgy business in the glamorous Grand Casino.

Title: 263. Lost Honeymoon
description: After an Englishwoman dies, leaving behind two children, her devoted friend decides to take the children to find the woman's husband, an American serviceman who had returned to the USA. But the father, now a successful architect, claims not to remember ever having gotten married or having any children.

Title: 264. Where There's Life
description: The American son of an Eastern European monarch wounded in an assassination attempt becomes a target for a terrorist organization.

Title: 265. Jugnu
description: Suraj and Jugnu's college romance is threatened by family obligations and financial struggles. Forced apart, they face devastating consequences. Their love is tested by societal expectations.

Title: 266. Calendar Girl
description: A songwriter finds out that his beautiful girlfriend is going to be an artist's model.

Title: 267. Voyage surprise
description: A guideless old tour proprietor trumps his new-fangled rival by offering a genuine mystery trip. The takers are a crowd of eccentrics and dropouts from all backgrounds.

Title: 268. The Arnelo Affair
description: A lawyer's wife starts an affair with a mobster but is confronted by his other flame who ends up murdered and the adulterous wife is set up to take the blame for the killing.

Title: 269. Border Feud
description: Two feuding families cause problems for Sheriff Fuzzy, and his old friend The Cheyenne Kid is called in to help.

Title: 270. Suddenly It's Spring
description: After serving overseas for four years, "Captain Lonelyhearts" is ready to give marriage a second chance, but her estranged husband has a new girlfriend who is eager to see the divorce papers signed.

Title: 271. Range Beyond the Blue
description: Eddie investigates, with the help of Soapy, a stagecoach line that's the target for bandits who want the gold shipments.

Title: 272. Cheyenne Takes Over
description: Cheyenne and sidekick Fuzzy uncover murder and corruption while on vacation.

Title: 273. I Wonder Who's Kissing Her Now
description: A biopic of the career of Joe Howard (12 February 1878 - 19 May 1961), famous songwriter of the early 20th Century. He wrote the title song, "Goodbye, My Lady Love" and "Hello, My Baby" among many others. Mark Stevens was dubbed by Buddy Clark, well known singer of the '30s and '40s.

Title: 274. The Ghosts of Berkeley Square
description: Ghosts are condemned to haunt a house until it is visited by a reigning monarch,

Title: 275. Fall Guy
description: Tom Cochrane (Leo Penn'), full of dope (cocaine) and covered with blood, is picked up by the police and then questioned by detectives Shannon (Douglas Fowley) and Taylor (Harry Strang), but manages to escape. His girl friend Lois Walter (Teala Loring) , against the wishes of her guardian, Jim Grosset (Charles Arnt), assists Tom and his police-officer brother-in-law Mac McLane (Robert Armstrong) in trying to clear Tom of a possible murder charge. Tom only recalls meeting a man in a bar and going to a party. Tom and Mac find the man, Joe (Elisha Cook Jr.), who takes them to the party scene, the apartment of the Sindells. They find the body of a murdered girl in the apartment above.

Title: 276. The Unfinished Dance
description: A young dance student accidentally cripples a teacher she doesn't like.

Title: 277. Miroir
description: Portrait of a two-faced man. By day he is rich, brilliant and respectable financial officer Lussac; at night, he becomes "Mirror", a ruthless gang leader in Marseilles.

Title: 278. Law of the Lash
description: U.S. marshal goes undercover to clean up a town run by bandits.

Title: 279. When You Come Home
description: A music hall odd-job man, put-upon at work and at home, finally decides to assert himself when the theatre is threatened by secret redevelopment plans.

Title: 280. Saddle Pals
description: Someone is trying to drive wealthy land owner Waldo Brooks into bankruptcy, and Gene is just the guy to expose the badguys.

Title: 281. The Brothers
description: The McFarishes and the Macraes are lifelong enemies living on a remote island in the Western Isles of Scotland. Mary Lawson is a Scottish orphan brought up in a convent who arrives on the weekly steamer to come and work as a servant to the Macraes. Mary is warned that she must have no dealings with the McFarish family but living a lonely life she encourages the friendship of Will McFarish, with tragic consequences.

Title: 282. Big Town After Dark
description: A crusading newspaper reporter battles big-city gambling interests.

Title: 283. The Smugglers
description: Told in flashback, this movie opens with a scene of a seventeen-year-old boy, Francis Andrews (Sir Richard Attenborough), being brutally lashed during a police interrogation, in which the boy thinks back to what placed him in this situation. He betrayed the crew of a smuggling ship whose master, Richard Carlyon (Sir Michael Redgrave), was also his guardian. Some of the smugglers are caught, but Carlyon escapes, and then begins his search for Andrews. Carlyon was quite fond of the boy, but knew him for a coward. Andrews seeks refuge in in the cottage of a girl named Elizabeth (Joan Greenwood), who urges him to give testimony against the smugglers in court. He summons his courage and does so. Carlyon, catching up with Andrews, recognizes this as an act of courage, and does not take revenge on him. Carlyon is eventually caught, but despite the police torture, Andrews does not identify him, and he goes free, while his guardian faces the gallows.

Title: 284. Marriage in the Shadows
description: In Nazi Germany actor Hans refuses to divorce his Jewish wife Elisabeth. He is threatened to be drafted and sent to the front while she will be deported to a concentration camp. Desperate, Hans decides that suicide is their only way out.

Title: 285. Ghost Town Renegades
description: Gold has been found and Sharp is out to get the land. He has the land owners killed and then has Watson forge new deeds. Cheyenne and Fuzzy arrive in time to save Trent. Then they go after the gang and its leader.

Title: 286. Pioneer Justice
description: Judd and his gang are driving the ranchers away. When Lash and Fuzzy arrest them, the Sheriff lets them go. Lash expected this and he hopes to follow them to their leader, the person he is really after.

Title: 287. I fratelli Karamazoff
description: When a tragedy strikes father Fyodor Karamazov, the wretched relation with his three sons reveals itself surrounded by intrigue, envy and deceit.

Title: 288. Last of the Redmen
description: A retelling of The Last of the Mohicans with just enough changes to qualify for a different title. Major Heyward and Hawk-Eye escort three children of an officer to safety during the French and Indian War. The addition of young Davy created several misadventures that enlivened the journey.

Title: 289. Return of the Lash
description: Cheyenne and Fuzzy get involved with a range war to help ranchers fight corruption.

Title: 290. To Live in Peace
description: The peaceful, almost idyllic life of an Italian village is interrupted during the war by the appearance of two American soldiers who keep hiding in the house of one of the villagers.

Title: 291. The Millerson Case
description: In the 8th "Crime Doctor" film, Dr. Ordway vacations in West Virginia when typhoid breaks out. After two typhoid-caused deaths, a third person, the town Romeo with many enemies, dies under more suspicious circumstances.

Title: 292. Dard
description: A boy is raised by a wealthy family and grows up to become a doctor. He visits a small village for a medical camp and falls in love with Hamida. Meanwhile, the rich man's daughter pines away for him.

Title: 293. Carnegie Hall
description: An Irish immigrant joins her mother working as a cleaner at Carnegie Hall, where encounters with residents influence her path. Features performances by renowned musicians Walter, Stokowski, Rubinstein, Haifetz, Pons, Peerce, and Monroe.

Title: 294. The Crime Doctor's Gamble
description: On a lecture/vacation visit to Paris, Dr. Ordway drops in on his friend, the Prefecture of Police. He becomes involved in a case involving the stabbing of an old man. The man's son, not all that mentally stable, believes he killed his own father in a rage because his father disliked his new bride, the daughter of a cabaret knife-thrower. Investigating the case, Ordway finds that the business of the legal copying art masterworks may also be involved.

Title: 295. Stallion Road
description: A veterinarian and rancher (Ronald Reagan) and a novelist (Zachary Scott) compete for the affections of a horse breeder (Alexis Smith) during an outbreak of anthrax.

Title: 296. Slavica
description: Slavica, Marin and a group of operants hide the newly built ship from the Italian occupation forces. They end up arrested, but the partisans rescue them and they take part in the string of actions.

Title: 297. Cinco rostros de mujer
description: A middle-aged man reminisces about the five women he loved.

Title: 298. Det kom en gäst...
description: The owner of an old mansion has decided to sell it. The next morning he is found murdered. Writer George Essman must try to figure out who the killer is.

Title: 299. King of the Bandits
description: Traveling north into Arizona, Cisco finds that someone committing robberies has been impersonating him and he is a wanted man. After retrieving some of the stolen loot, he is caught with it in his posession and put in the guard house. A friend whose life he recently saved beaks him out and Cisco heads out to find the impersonator and clear himself.

Title: 300. The Trouble with Women
description: A psychology professor comes up with a theory that women have a desire to be subjugated. A newswoman, using a pseudonym, accuses him of advocating wife-beating. There is trouble after he falls in love with her, unaware of who she is.

Title: 301. The Ball at the Anjo House
description: After Japan's loss in the war, the wealthy, cultured, liberal Anjo family have to give up their mansion and their way of life. They hold one last ball at the house before leaving. The seemingly cold, cynical son secretly grieves for his defeated father and the values that the war destroyed, while the daughter tries to prevent the father from taking his life and to find her own place in the new Japan.

Title: 302. The Crab with the Golden Claws
description: In pursuit of mysterious boxes of crab, Tintin will meet the one who will become his inseparable friend: Captain Haddock.

Title: 303. Philo Vance's Gamble
description: Philo goes after a gang of murderous jewel thieves.

Title: 304. The Burning Cross
description: Johnny, who is a returning veteran unable to adjust to his old life in his home town, succumbs to the pitch of a Ku Klux Klan organizer. It is only after he has worn the Klan sheet, and gone out on some raids, that he begins to realize what he has let himself in for; he is filled with horror and remorse when he sees the homes of neighbors burned, an old friend who defies the Klan killed, and his own wheel-chair father badly beaten. He meets with the State prosecutor, admits his own participation, and agrees to help bring down the Klan in his town.

Title: 305. Song of Scheherazade
description: In 1865, Russian Navy midshipman Rimsky-Korsakov is inspired by a romantic interlude with a cabaret dancer while on shore leave in Spanish Morocco and writes the symphonic suite Scheherazade.

Title: 306. King of the Wild Horses
description: A heart-warming story about a boy and a horse, emphasizing the boy's devotion to the equine and his belief that wild horses should be free to roam the plains.

Title: 307. Blackmail
description: A private detective is approached by a wealthy entertainment executive to stop a blackmail scheme against him. Although he hasn't decided to take the job, the blackmailers believe that he already has, and he is marked for murder.

Title: 308. Lise kommer til Byen
description: Lise walks around with big star dreams in a small town. For now, she has to settle for singing in the local church, but when a film crew comes to the village, she might get the chance of a lifetime. It starts badly, however, as she gives the director a concussion in the belief that he is an assailant.

Title: 309. Vigilantes of Boomtown
description: The ranch of Red Ryder and his aunt, The Duchess, is being used as the training site for "Gentleman Jim" Corbett for his upcoming fight in Carson City, Nevada for the heavyweight championship against Bob Fitzsimmons.

Title: 311. Hi De Ho
description: Cab Calloway plays himself in a plot about jealousy, night clubs, and gangsters. Ends with a series of musical numbers.

Title: 312. The Red Stallion
description: A mare dies while foaling the Red Stallion. He is reared by a boy and is entered in a big race - something like the Kentucky Derby.

Title: 313. Der Hofrat Geiger
description: Franz Geiger discovers that he has a daughter, Mariandl, the result of a love affair in Spitz eighteen years earlier.

Title: 314. The Law Comes to Gunsight
description: A mayor hires Pecos to deal with a gambling boss, but Pecos dies fighting Johnny Macklin. Johnny's mistaken for Pecos, becomes sheriff, battles corruption, and finds romance while cleaning up Gunsight with help from locals.

Title: 315. Railroad Workers
description: The north of Sweden in 1902. A team of railroad men are building a rail road from Luleå at the Bay of Bothnia to Narvik at the Norwegian Sea. One of the newest workers, Valfrid from the south of Sweden, is not accepted by neither Stora Ballong, the informal leader of the workers, nor the others. They refuse to talk to him but instead Valfrid gets help from the sworn enemy of the railroad workers: the greedy drugstore owner Blom.

Title: 316. Heading for Heaven
description: When small-town real estate agent Henry learns that he hasn't long to live he desperately tries to sell his own worthless property to provide for his family. When an airline gets interested in the lot Henry is conned by a gang of crooks.

Title: 317. Fado, História d'uma Cantadeira
description: Ana Maria was a modest young woman who loves Júlio, her guitarist. But when she becomes a famous singer and Júlio, feeling abandoned by her, decides to go to the African colonies, she will have to choose between fame and true love.

Title: 318. La figlia del capitano
description: Literary adaptation: A peasant leader under the enlightened despotism of Empress Catherine the Great, and a love story.

Title: 319. Easy Come, Easy Go
description: A film that possibly held the record for the most Irish-descent players in an American-produced movie before "The Quiet Man" was shot on location in Ireland, and that includes "The Informer." Barry Fitzgerald is a rapid fan of following the ponies (but none too good at picking the winners)and owns a shabby boarding house east of NYC's Third Avenue. Mostly, he never works, follows his hunches, philosphizes through most of the 77 minutes and changes the life course for most of those around him. His dependence upon his daughter (Diana Lynn) keeps him interfering with her romance with a returning WW II sailor (Sonny Tufts, just before Paramount finally gave up on him.) And he will stretch the truth beyond accepted boundaries. Fitzgerald's real-life brother Arthur Sheilds plays his brother who he has built up to be a rich man, but who is really a diver working for the police department. Could have been a ten if there had been a leprechaun or two or Pat O'Brien in the cast.

Title: 320. Thunder Mountain
description: Marvin Hayden returns to find his ranch is about to be sold at auction and the Hayden Jorth feud still going strong. Carson wants the Hayden ranch and tries to kill Hayden. When he fails he kills Chick Jorth with a rock. As Hayden does not carry a gun and the two had argued earlier, Hayden is arrested for the murder. With Hayden in jail, his friends Chito, Ginger, and his Lawyer Gardner now go to work to find the murderer.

Title: 321. While I Live
description: 25 years later, a spinster still obsesses over the death of her composer sister and concludes she has returned, reincarnated, in an amnesiac woman who chances upon her house seeking help.

Title: 322. When a Girl's Beautiful
description: Model Adele Jordon breaks up with the model-agency's wealthiest perfume client, and he requests a new model who possesses all of the elements of beauty for their new campaign. Johnny Hanley, a promotion man, submits a composite photograph of the best features from all the models...and comes up with Marjorie Main. Well, maybe not, but anybody who can't guess the ending wasn't paying any attention to the plot premise set-up.

Title: 323. Fame Is the Spur
description: A British politician finds that his intense liberal views become more conservative with his rise to power.

Title: 324. Black Hills
description: Two frontiersmen try to avenge the murder of a struggling rancher.

Title: 325. Phoenix
description: A young war widow remembers her short time with her husband.

Title: 326. Woman Without a Face
description: Martin and Frida married solely because she was pregnant. Later he would have a passionate side-affair with Rut. Rut's sexual feelings were highly neurotic because she had been sexually abused by her stepfather. When the chimney sweep came, she seduced him and afterward felt dirty and desperate.
